summary: Frontend-only testing for multi-page Cris du Coeur site. All 6 routes load without console errors. Navbar, mobile menu, cart, contact form, cause/event/product cards, team members, donation flow, and cross-page nav-donate scroll all work as specified. 100% of required test cases pass on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x844).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-page React Router site. All data-testid selectors match spec. Verified: all 6 routes load, navbar links + logo-home navigate correctly, scroll-to-top on route change works, nav-donate-button from subpage navigates home and scrolls to final-cta-section (scrollY ~5412), cause-card-0..3 + cause-donate-{i} navigate to home donation section, event-card-0..3 + event-register toasts, product-card-0..5 + add-to-cart increments cart-indicator ('Panier (0)'->'Panier (2)'), team-member-0..3 render, contact-form empty submit shows error toast, valid submit clears form, mobile-menu-toggle opens mobile-menu with mobile-nav-* links working, donation submit-donation-button shows success toast on home.
